**Job Description**
**Job Title: AI Application Engineer**
 Johnson Controls International (JCI) is seeking AI Application Modernization Engineer to join our Digital Transformation team. This role is ideal for an experienced software engineer with deep expertise in legacy application modernization, AI\-assisted software development, and Microsoft cloud technologies.
   

  

 As AI Application Modernization Engineer, you will lead the transformation of mission\-critical business applications built on VB6 front\-end technologies and IBM i (AS400\) platforms, including Synon, RPG, RPGLE, and CLP. You will leverage AI and Generative AI technologies to accelerate code conversion, application modernization, testing, documentation, and deployment to modern Microsoft platforms.
   

  

 You will play a critical role in reducing technical debt, improving application maintainability, and accelerating JCI's digital transformation strategy through scalable, cloud\-ready solutions.
   

  

**How You Will Do It**
**AI\-Powered Application Modernization**
* Hands on application development to modernization of legacy applications built using VB6, Synon, RPG, RPGLE, CLP, and IBM i (AS400\) technologies.
* Utilize Generative AI, GitHub Copilot, Azure OpenAI, and AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate code analysis, conversion, testing, and documentation.
* Design and execute migration strategies from legacy platforms to modern Microsoft technologies.
* Develop reusable modernization frameworks, patterns, and best practices for enterprise\-scale application transformation.


**Microsoft Development \& Cloud Engineering**
* Design and develop modern business applications using Microsoft technologies including C\#, .NET 8\+, ASP.NET Core, and .NET MAUI.
* Modernize desktop applications into cloud\-enabled and cross\-platform solutions within the Microsoft ecosystem.
* Design API\-first architectures and service\-based integrations using Azure services.
* Collaborate with enterprise architects, infrastructure teams, and business stakeholders to deliver secure and scalable solutions.


**AI Strategy \& Engineering Excellence**
* Identify opportunities to apply AI and Generative AI to improve software engineering productivity and modernization outcomes.
* Lead proof\-of\-concepts and pilots demonstrating AI\-driven modernization capabilities.
* Establish engineering standards, governance, and best practices for AI\-assisted application development.
* Mentor development teams on modernization approaches, AI tools, and Microsoft development platforms.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related discipline.
* 5\+ years of software development experience.
* 5\+ years of experience with VB6 application development and maintenance.
* Proven experience modernizing legacy applications to Microsoft technologies.
* Experience delivering large\-scale application modernization or migration programs.
* Hands\-on experience using AI\-assisted software development tools and Generative AI technologies.
* Experience working with enterprise business\-critical applications and complex integrations.


**Technical Expertise**
**Front\-End Technologies \-** 
 Visual Basic 6 (VB6\), C\#, .NET Framework, .NET 8\+, ASP.NET Core, .NET MAUI, WinUI, WPF, XAML, HTML5, JavaScript
   

  

**Back\-End Technologies**
 Synon (CA 2E), RPG, RPGLE, CLP, IBM i / AS400, DB2, SQL Server, Stored Procedures, API Development
   

  

**AI \& Modernization Technologies**
 Azure OpenAI
 **,** 
 GitHub Copilot Enterprise, Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI Services, AI\-assisted code conversion tools, Prompt Engineering, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG)
   

  

**Cloud \& DevOps**
 Microsoft Azure, Azure DevOps, GitHub, Azure App Services, Azure Functions, Azure API Management, Power Platform, CI/CD Pipelines
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience converting VB6 applications to .NET MAUI, WinUI, or modern Microsoft technologies.
* Experience modernizing Synon, RPG, RPGLE, or AS400 applications.
* Experience with Azure\-based application modernization programs.
* Knowledge of enterprise architecture, application rationalization, and technical debt reduction strategies.
* Experience within manufacturing, industrial, or enterprise ERP environments.
* Microsoft Azure certifications preferred.


**Ideal Candidate:** 
 An engineer who has successfully delivered VB6 and AS400 modernization programs and has leveraged AI technologies to accelerate application conversion to modern Microsoft platforms such as .NET, MAUI, Azure, and Power Platform.
